statement: Species I.1 has all 27 lines real; the complex count gives the matching upper bound.

source.location: Art 5, first case A, printed p.197
source.version: Original Philosophical Transactions 153(1863),193–241; JSTOR original-journal scan

scope: Nonsingular real cubic surfaces in real projective three-space; count real projective lines, not only lines with a specified affine incidence.
notes: The five-species source analysis includes generic canonical forms; modern all-smooth formulations are separate literature.
